title: State issues warning to Harris County judge from viral video of confrontation with IT tech
text:
Texas officials issue warning to Harris County judge from viral video of confrontation with IT tech - ABC13 Houston 
 24/7 Live Houston Southwest Southeast Northwest Northeast Judge 
 State issues warning to Harris County judge from viral video of confrontation with IT tech 
 Harris County Judge Nathan Milliron's behavior is in the spotlight again. 
 The state has issued a public warning to the Harris County Judge, who previously drew widespread attention after a viral video showed him verbally berating an IT tech. Monday, November 16, 2026 5:45PM Share Follow ABC13 on Google The state has issued a public warning to the Harris County Judge, who previously received widespread attention from a viral video of him verbally berating an IT tech.
 The video, which circulated widely online in March, showed Harris County Judge Nathan Milliron in a tense exchange with an IT worker who had come to help with a computer issue in the courtroom.
 ORIGINAL REPORT: Harris County judge grabs internet's attention after confrontation with IT technician 
 On Friday, ABC13 learned that the State Commission on Judicial Conduct issued Milliron a warning for his behavior in three incidents, records stated.

 Milliron received a warning for his behavior in the viral video, and another for the language he used in emails and texts to the District Clerk's Office about his staffing, records said. The third incident happened in March when Milliron threatened to have a lawyer arrested after they asked to approach the bench, records stated.
 The warning states that Milliron failed to be "patient, dignified and courteous."
